interpretation.conditioning: policy-defined optional exposure, descriptive and not pretreatment causal adjustment
interpretation.group_contribution: sum(mask * paired quantity)/N; additive over four primary groups; both subgroups partition only both
interpretation.scope: all previously inspected original no-loop same-state arrays; no new test population, inference, graph permutations or autonomous rollout
interpretation.units: normalized acceleration coordinate squared error; vector error/alignment/cost divided by2
interpretation.weighted_conditional: fixed frame/trajectory-weighted contribution divided by fixed-weight fraction, never an available-frame mean

publication.projection: Original top-level values and every model aggregate except per-trajectory records; exact result retains all trajectories and indices. Every original per-frame JSON is retained in the archive.
